parsed.explanation: Worst documented feature is tier-2 state-tolerated targeting: police routinely detain trans/gender-nonconforming people on pretexts like 'drunk and disorderly', extort cash, hold them without charge, and officers have raped detainees; custody placement by birth sex is unresolved and a 2025 High Court found a trans prisoner subjected to nonconsensual medical procedures and court-ordered 'gender determination'. Bathroom use draws accusations of sexual offences; no anti-discrimination statute exists; a dormant sodomy statute (14 years) is a lever against trans women with male partners. Positives are real but court-bound: forced anal exams struck down (compensation 2024), association upheld (2023), gender-marker ruling (2026), yet no enacted statute and no documented discipline of abusive officers. Remedies for police predation are absent; oversight findings recur without change. Above the 0.15 tier (no presentation offence, no registry, courts grant relief), below Orenna-style 0.35 because custody harm is documented, not unknown. Border treatment undocumented.
